newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hunter Douglas Q1 net up 20 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hunter Douglas Q1 net up 20 percent.

text.p: Window blinds maker Hunter Douglas said on Tuesday net profit in the first quarter of 1997 rose 20 percent, and repeated its upbeat outlook for the year.

The firm, publishing quarterly results for the first time, said first quarter net profit climbed to 30.3 million guilders ($15.8 million) from 25.3 million in the first quarter of 1996, boosted by a firm dollar. Sales rose 13.4 percent to 570.2 million guilders.
"The first quarter results confirm the Group's previously expressed optimistic outlook for the full year," Hunter Douglas said in a statement.
Hunter Douglas said in March it was optimistic for 1997, given its strong performance in North America, Asia and Latin America and an expected pick-up in its European and Australian business.
"Sales in North America, Latin America and Asia continued their strong growth," the company said in its statement, adding sales in Europe were flat, while Australian sales declined.
It said sales volume accounted for 3.5 percent of the increase in turnover, acquisitions for 2.2 percent and currency differences for 7.7 percent.

Hunter Douglas shares were down 0.50 guilders on the results to 176.00 guilders, moving against the trend in a higher Amsterdam market. Analysts had not published forecasts for the results as no comparisons had been available.
